SELECT stock_item_id,
    round(avg(rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
    count(*) AS review_count
   FROM customer_product_reviews
  WHERE status = 'approved'::product_review_status
  GROUP BY stock_item_id;

SELECT si.id AS stock_item_id,
    si.oem_part_number,
    si.description,
    COALESCE(sum(sl.quantity), 0::numeric) AS qty_total,
    COALESCE(sum(sl.quantity) FILTER (WHERE w.role_code = 'WH1'::text OR (w.code::text = ANY (ARRAY['WH1'::character varying::text, 'MAIN'::character varying::text]))), 0::numeric) AS qty_wh1,
    COALESCE(sum(sl.quantity) FILTER (WHERE w.role_code = 'WH2'::text OR w.code::text = 'WH2'::text), 0::numeric) AS qty_wh2
   FROM stock_items si
     LEFT JOIN stock_levels sl ON sl.stock_item_id = si.id
     LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = sl.warehouse_id AND w.is_active
  GROUP BY si.id, si.oem_part_number, si.description;
